get.description: Returns a single sheet of a character owned by the logged-in user, with fresh temporary URLs (the ones returned by the list expire after a few minutes).

400.description: Sheet identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Sheet not found, or its character is owned by another user

put.description: Replaces title and game system of a sheet of a character owned by the logged-in user. Fields not sent are set to empty (the title cannot be empty). The PDF file is not changed.

400.description: Invalid request body (for example blank title), or sheet identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Sheet not found, or its character is owned by another user

409.description: The sheet was modified at the same time by another request: nothing is saved, read it again and retry

delete.description: Deletes a sheet of a character owned by the logged-in user, together with its PDF file. The operation cannot be undone.

400.description: Sheet identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Sheet not found, or its character is owned by another user

put.summary: Replace the PDF of a sheet
put.description: Uploads a PDF that replaces the file of a sheet of a character owned by the logged-in user. Title and game system are kept. The same checks as the upload of a new sheet apply. The previous file is replaced and deleted.

file.description: The PDF file that replaces the current one

400.description: Missing file part, malformed multipart request, empty file, file that is not a PDF, missing or mismatching content type, extension not matching the content, file too large, or sheet identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Sheet not found, or its character is owned by another user

409.description: The sheet was modified at the same time by another request: the PDF is not changed, try again

413.description: File larger than the maximum request size

put.description: Replaces the content of a page. The page number cannot be changed directly and the page cannot be moved to another diary. The content must be a document of the diary editor: a doc node with paragraphs (optionally aligned left, center, right or justify), blockquotes, bullet and ordered lists and horizontal rules, where the text and the hard breaks can carry the marks bold, italic, underline, title (level 1 or 2) and textColor (a color of the palette: red, orange, green, teal, blue, purple, magenta or brown). Any other node, mark or property is rejected. The content must not exceed the configured maximum size. The request must carry the version of the page the client last read: if the page was modified in the meantime nothing is saved and the response is 409. The response carries the new version, to be used for the next update.

200.description: Page updated, with the new version of the page

400.description: Invalid request body (for example empty content or missing version), content that is not a valid diary document, content too large, or page identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Page not found, or its character is owned by another user

409.description: The page was modified in the meantime (another tab or device, or a deletion that renumbered it): nothing is saved and the page must be read again

delete.description: Deletes a page of a diary of a character owned by the logged-in user. The pages that follow are renumbered, so the numbers stay consecutive. The identifiers of the pages do not change.

400.description: Page identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Page not found, its character is owned by another user, or the page was deleted at the same time

409.description: A page of the diary was modified at the same time by another request: nothing is deleted, try again

put.summary: Set the tag of a page
put.description: Replaces the tag of a page of a diary of a character owned by the logged-in user. A page has at most one tag, 1 to 30 characters without control characters; a null tag removes it. A diary can have at most 10 different tags (ignoring case): if the diary already has the tag with another case, that spelling is kept. The tag is not part of the page content: saving it does not change the version of the page. The response gives the tag the page has now (null if none).

200.description: Tag replaced, with the tag the page has now

400.description: Invalid request body (blank or too long tag, control characters, characters that cannot be stored), a new tag when the diary already has 10 different tags, or page identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Page not found, its character is owned by another user, or the page was deleted at the same time

put.summary: Set the profile image of the logged-in user
put.description: Uploads an image (png, jpeg or webp) as profile image of the logged-in user. The real content of the file is checked, not only the declared type: the file type must be an allowed image, the declared content type must be present and, like the extension, must match the content and the size must not exceed the configured limit. The previous profile image, if any, is replaced and its file is deleted. Returns a temporary URL of the new image, valid for a few minutes.

file.description: The image to use as profile image (png, jpeg or webp)

200.description: Profile image set, with its temporary URL as payload

400.description: Missing file part, malformed multipart request, empty file, unsupported file type, missing or mismatching content type, extension not matching the content, or file too large

404.description: The user has not been created yet (call POST /me first)

get.description: Returns the email, the premium flag and the settings of the logged-in user, identified by the access token.

404.description: The user has not been created yet (call POST /me first)

post.description: To be called once after every login. Creates the user in the backend the first time, otherwise keeps the email aligned with the access token, and returns the identifier of the user. It is idempotent: calling it again returns the same identifier. Call it again after the email has been changed on the authentication server and the access token has been refreshed: the stored email is aligned with the one in the token.

200.description: The identifier of the logged-in user

400.description: The token has no email address

409.description: The user was modified at the same time by another request, try again

delete.summary: Delete the account and all the data of the logged-in user
delete.description: Permanently deletes the account of the logged-in user: first the user on the authentication server (Keycloak, retried three times with growing waits if it fails; an already deleted user counts as done), then everything the user has in the backend: all the characters with their diaries and pages, the profile image, the images of characters and diaries (files included) and the user itself. It cannot be undone. The payments of the user are not deleted: they are kept, detached from the account, because the law requires to retain them. Everything is deleted in a single transaction: if something fails nothing is deleted. If the authentication server cannot delete the user after the retries it answers 502 and deletes nothing in the backend. It requires a recent login with the password (the auth_time claim of the token, five minutes by default): otherwise it answers 401 and deletes nothing. It is idempotent: if the user has no data any more it still answers 200.

401.description: Missing, expired or invalid token, or the last login with the password is older than app.user.delete-max-auth-age (the answer carries WWW-Authenticate with error insufficient_user_authentication and the client must ask for the password again)

409.description: The account changed while it was being deleted (for example a character was created at the same time): nothing is deleted in the backend (the user on the authentication server is already gone, so calling again goes straight to the data), try again

502.description: The user could not be deleted on the authentication server after the retries: nothing is deleted in the backend, try again later

get.description: Admin only. Returns a page of the received feedback, newest first by default, filtered and sorted according to the search parameters (type, status, text contained in the email, and the period of reception: createdFrom and createdTo are dates without time, both included, from 00:00:00 of the first day to 23:59:59 of the last day in the time zone app.feedback.timezone, each one can be used alone or together).

200.description: Page of feedback (empty list if none)

400.description: Invalid search parameters (for example page below 1, size above 100, unknown type or status, date that is not in the format yyyy-MM-dd, or createdFrom after createdTo)

403.description: The user does not have the admin role

post.description: Public endpoint, no token needed. Multipart request with the form fields and up to app.feedback.max-files images (default 3) in the repeated part 'files', for a total of at most app.feedback.max-total-file-size (default 5 MB). Images must be PNG, JPEG or WebP: the real content of each file is checked, not only the declared type, and the declared content type and the extension must match the content. Empty file parts are ignored. The privacy consent is mandatory. The field 'website' is a trap for bots: if it is filled, the request answers 201 but nothing is saved. Each client address can send a limited number of requests per period (app.feedback.rate-limit-max-requests per app.feedback.rate-limit-window).

201.description: Feedback received (also when it was discarded by the trap field)

400.description: Invalid fields (unknown type, blank or too long message, missing or invalid email, consent missing or false), technical information that is not a JSON object or too large, too many files, files too large in total, empty or unsupported file, declared content type or extension not matching the content, or malformed multipart request

413.description: Request larger than the maximum request size

429.description: Too many submissions from the same address, see the Retry-After header

get.summary: List the pages of a diary
get.description: Returns two pages at a time of a diary of a character owned by the logged-in user, with their content, sorted by page number. Use page=1 for pages 1 and 2, page=2 for pages 3 and 4, and so on. The last spread can contain a single page. A page beyond the end returns an empty list.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Number of the spread to read (1-based), two pages at a time

400.description: Invalid page parameter (below 1 or not a number), or diary identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Diary not found, or its character is owned by another user

post.description: Adds a page at the end of a diary of a character owned by the logged-in user. The page number is assigned by the server (the next one after the last page) and a diary can have at most 100 pages. The content must be a document of the diary editor: a doc node with paragraphs (optionally aligned left, center, right or justify), blockquotes, bullet and ordered lists and horizontal rules, where the text and the hard breaks can carry the marks bold, italic, underline, title (level 1 or 2) and textColor (a color of the palette: red, orange, green, teal, blue, purple, magenta or brown). Any other node, mark or property is rejected. The content must not exceed the configured maximum size.

parameters.name: diaryId
parameters.description: Identifier of the diary the page belongs to

400.description: Invalid request body (for example empty content), content that is not a valid diary document, diary full (100 pages), page added at the same time by another request, content too large, or diary identifier that is not a UUID

403.description: The user has neither the user nor the admin role

404.description: Diary not found, its character is owned by another user, or the diary was deleted while the page was being created
